name: Tower defense
core_loop: Read the lane and the coming wave
Spend gold on a tower where the path bends
Watch the wave break on the towers and bank the bounty
Upgrade or sell before the next wave releases

questions.question: How many waves should a run last?
How many tower types should the first build offer?

acceptance.promise: Placing a tower spends its cost and the tower only fires inside its range.
setup: Set the build purse to exactly build_cost
Send one creep down the lane
probes: Place one tower on a build slot and read the purse
Attempt a second placement and read the purse and slot state
Sample the tower's target while the creep is outside and inside attack_range
evidence: The purse falls by build_cost on the first placement
The second placement is refused and the purse is unchanged
The tower acquires the creep only inside attack_range and fires at fire_rate

acceptance.promise: A creep that reaches the base costs base health, and zero health ends the run.
setup: Set base health to a small value
probes: Release one wave and read the base health after the first leak
Let the base health reach zero and read the run result
Clear every wave in a second run and read the run result
evidence: Base health falls by one per leaked creep
The run reports a loss when base health reaches zero
Surviving wave_count waves reports a win
